name: fdm_common_muon_m1
machine_start_gcode:
PRINT_START EXTRUDER=[nozzle_temperature_initial_layer] BED=[bed_temperature_initial_layer_single] MATERIAL=[filament_type[initial_extruder]] MESH_MIN={adaptive_bed_mesh_min[0]},{adaptive_bed_mesh_min[1]} MESH_MAX={adaptive_bed_mesh_max[0]},{adaptive_bed_mesh_max[1]} PROBE_COUNT={bed_mesh_probe_count[0]},{bed_mesh_probe_count[1]} ALGORITHM=[bed_mesh_algo]

G90               ; absolute XYZ mode
M83               ; relative E mode

; Front-right corner purge, as it was before KAN-990 (and before KAN-6145 moved it to X10-70):
; X130-200 along the front edge, right of the no-go notch (x80.5-119.5, y0-22.6). It runs from Y0 up
; (it used to start at Y -1.5): the printer's Y travel now ends at -1.
SET_VELOCITY_LIMIT ACCEL=5000   ; gentle move to the purge: at full acceleration it skipped steps;
                                ; the slice sets its own acceleration from the first layer on
G0 X130.0 Y0 F8000      ; move to the start of the purge

SPEED_SLOW_PRE_PURGE_FOR_TPU MATERIAL=[filament_type[initial_extruder]]

; --- Drop to first-layer height and prime a little
G0 Z0.15
G1 X134 E5 F300

; --- Begin modified L-shaped wipe ---

; 1) Horizontal long wipe from (134, 0) to (200, 0)
G1 X200 Y0 E20 F800

; 2) Vertical move up from (200, 0) to (200, 6)
G1 Y6 E1 F800

; 3) Small back move to relieve pressure
G1 X199.5 E-0.2

; 4) Vertical move down from (199.5, 6)
G1 Y1 E0.7 F600

; 5) Horizontal return wipe from (199.5, 1) back to (130, 1)
G1 X130 E7.5 F600

SPEED_NORMAL__POST_PURGE_FOR_TPU MATERIAL=[filament_type[initial_extruder]]

G1 Z0.1 F800
G1 Y2.5 F1200

; --- End modified L-shaped wipe ---

; Lift clear of the front notch before the first travel. The purge ends at X130 Y2.5, Z0.1, and the
; first travel goes straight to the first object, so at that height it can cross the notch
; (x80.5-119.5, y0-22.6, Z 0..5), which needs Z6 (C2 muon.m1-geometry v2, no_go.traverse_z).
G1 Z6 F800

M400                           ; wait for all moves to finish before continuing
